question: List the long names of buildings constructed before 1950 that have more than 100 employees, the built year of the building, and number of employees.

access_trace.sql:
SELECT
    fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    fb.DATE_BUILT,
    COUNT(ed.MIT_ID) AS employee_count
FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb
JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN DRUPAL_EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ed.OFFICE_LOCATION
WHERE YEAR(fb.DATE_BUILT) < 1950
GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fb.DATE_BUILT
HAVING COUNT(ed.MIT_ID) > 100
